briefs.claim_en: COVID-19 vaccines contain microchips to track every vaccinated person.
briefs.brief_en: Official public health authorities and independent fact-checkers consistently state that COVID-19 vaccines do not contain microchips or tracking mechanisms. The U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention stated on 2023-02-16 that authorized vaccines contain no microchips and function solely to stimulate immune antibody production. In Indonesia, the Ministry of Communication and Information Technology stated on 2021-01-21 that tracking devices and barcodes exist solely on supply chain packaging and vials, not within injectable vaccines. Fact-checking organizations, including AFP Fact Check on 2021-07-02 and FactCheck.org on 2020-12-15, noted that claims stemmed from misinterpretations of external RFID packaging sensors and health monitoring research, confirming vaccines possess no capability to track individuals.
gaps_en: No evidence supporting the presence of microchips or tracking devices in any authorized COVID-19 vaccine was identified.
